summary: Live read-only Android emulator smoke for the ForgeLink mobile cockpit device-health seam.

commands.summary: Started the installed Android emulator AVD in a headless smoke configuration.

commands.command: C:\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe wait-for-device; adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed; adb devices -l; adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release; adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk; adb shell getprop ro.product.model; adb shell getprop ro.hardware
commands.summary: Emulator booted successfully: emulator-5554, Android 15, SDK 35, model Android SDK built for x86_64, hardware ranchu.

Moto One Hyper read-only bridge returned ok:true operator-status payload with authority readonly-emulator-inspection, bridge_version rom_lab.forgelink_operator_status.v1, boot.completed=true, packages.count=40, and sanitized network/storage/activity summaries.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed after evidence update.

environment.process_note: Read-only emulator/device-health smoke only. This proves the advisory operator-status seam against a booted Android emulator. It does not install or run a packaged Tauri APK/IPA, does not pair a device key, does not return a signed decision envelope from a packaged app, and does not mutate the emulator.
